author: Old Dominion News
title: Quioccasin Middle School teacher Matt Thompson honored as 'Yay of the Day' recipient
text:
Matt Thompson, a math teacher at Quioccasin Middle School, was recognized as the “Yay of the Day” honoree, according to an announcement made by Superintendent Amy Cashwell on April 22. The recognition took place at Quioccasin Middle School.
The award highlights efforts by educators who make a positive impact in their school communities. Henrico County Public Schools has emphasized delivering positive learning experiences through dedicated staff in both educational and support roles, as noted on the official website.
Thompson was nominated by Jen Bowen for his commitment to student well-being and classroom inclusivity. Bowen said, “He cares for the physical and educational well-being of students. Mr. Thompson has been helping a student (who adores him) to acclimate to a new medical diagnosis while promoting classroom inclusivity. By providing our student with sugar-free snacks to enjoy with peers in class and always cheerfully accommodating class disruptions by the clinic, Mr. Thompson has helped a potentially scary, life-altering diagnosis to be manageable to this young man. When this student is in the clinic he is frequently complimentary of his favorite teacher and the ways Mr. Thompson has been helpful, so his nurse promised to help acknowledge the way he positively impacts others!”
Henrico County Public Schools provides educational services throughout Henrico County, Virginia—adjacent to Richmond—and has received accolades for teaching excellence including REB Awards for classroom performance and professional development according to its official website .
Cashwell serves as superintendent of Henrico County Public Schools according to district information . The district operates under the motto “The right to achieve. The support to succeed,” reflecting its commitment across all schools as stated online .
Broader recognition programs like “Yay of the Day” continue throughout Henrico County Public Schools as part of ongoing efforts to acknowledge staff contributions that advance student success.
